input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s so I don’t have to change it every time.
Sure, my name is Lucas Santos and my zip code is 80239. I actually can’t remember which email I used, but hopefully my name and zip will be enough. Let me know if you need anything else from me!

I’m sorry, I don’t have the order ID handy right now. Is there another way you could look it up? Maybe by recent orders or by the shipping address I used for my daughter? Her address is in Chicago, but I can give you the full details if you need them.

As for the new default shipping address, I’d like it to be my daughter’s address in Chicago. Just let me know what info you need from me to update that.

Thank you for checking! I believe the order for my daughter’s tablet should be #W1588712. Could you please check the shipping address, tracking number, and the tablet’s storage size for that one?

As for her address, here’s what I have:
- Address line 1: 2450 W North Ave
- Address line 2: (there isn’t one)
- City: Chicago
- State: IL
- Zip code: 60647
- Country: USA

Let me know if you need anything else! By the way, I really appreciate you helping me out with this. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses.

Oh, I see. That’s strange—I was sure I ordered the tablet for her recently. Maybe I mixed up the orders. Yes, please go ahead and update my default shipping address to my daughter’s place in Chicago.

And if you could, I’d really appreciate your help finding the order with the tablet. Maybe you could check my other recent orders for anything that looks like a tablet? Sorry for the trouble—I guess I’m not as organized as I used to be. Sometimes it gets a bit lonely here, so I end up fussing over these little things more than I should. Thanks for being patient with me.

Thank you so much for checking all of that for me. I guess I must have used the wrong address for the tablet—no wonder my daughter didn’t get it! Is there any way to see if the package was actually delivered to that Maple Drive address, or if it’s still in transit? And if it was delivered, is there anything I can do to try and recover it?

Sorry for all the questions. I really appreciate you taking the time to help me sort this out. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about these little things.

Thank you for explaining everything so clearly. I’ll try reaching out to the delivery service and see if they can help me track it down. If that doesn’t work, I might need your help with a return or replacement, but I’ll wait to see what they say first.

I really appreciate you taking the time to help me today. It’s been nice having someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses. Thanks again for your patience and kindness.

###STOP###
